items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: *Sonny Rollins, not Coltrane, practiced on the walkway of the Williamsburgh Bridge during his voluntary retirement of 1959-1961.

ctx.x: I mean, some of these guys, conservatory musicians talk about jazz players, they ought to practice one-half as hard and one-half as intelligently or as musically as these guys. Because these guys were not only practicing the technique of their instruments, like Ben would permute, you know, but he was practicing instant composition at the same time, you know. Theory, in the hands of guys like Ben Webster, and you told me about Dizzy, I know Dizzy really knows what he's doing, theory

was not the right word to use for them, because what they were doing wasn't theory, they made it reality, you know. They were doing it, it wasn't theory. They turned it into the real thing.
